steps.title: Three steps to a first landed cost
steps.oneHint: CSV or Excel, Sage, EBP or Odoo export: columns are detected, nothing is written before you confirm.
steps.two: Add a container and load lines into it
steps.twoHint: ISO number above, then inside the container: which quantity of which line is on board.

steps.threeHint: Ocean freight, THC, duty: one amount, one method, and the unit cost per SKU appears.

notFound.title: Container not found
notFound.body: It may belong to another organization or have been archived.

tracking.title: Tracking
tracking.manualNote: manual until a provider is connected
tracking.providerHelp: Used when you click "Track this container". Manual: you enter the events. Terminal49 and Shipsgo: events arrive by themselves, with an API key set on the server.

loads.empty: Nothing loaded yet. Costs cannot be allocated until a purchase-order line is in this container.
loads.alreadyLoaded: This line is already loaded here.

form.amountInvalid: The amount must be a positive number with at most two decimals.
form.dutyNote: Customs duty is allocated on the CIF basis, by theoretical duty when every line has a duty rate.

allocation.title: Landed cost per purchase-order line
allocation.empty: No purchase-order line loaded. Add loads first.

purchaseOrder.addCostCard: Add a cost on this order

notFound.title: Purchase order not found
notFound.body: It may belong to another organization or have been deleted.

imports.title: Imports
imports.subtitle: Purchase orders and container loads from CSV or Excel

importWizard.title: Import purchase orders
importWizard.subtitle: Upload, map the columns, review the validation report, then commit. Nothing is written before the last step.

upload.kindPurchaseOrders: One row per purchase-order line (SKU, quantity, unit price, optional container)
upload.kindLegacy: One row per purchase order with a total value and a container
upload.cta: Click to choose a CSV or XLSX
upload.hint: Excel FR exports (BOM, semicolons, French decimals) are fine.

review.errorSummary: {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} with {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}} will be skipped
review.orFix: or fix the file and upload again

done.summary: {pos, plural, one {# purchase order} other {# purchase orders}}, {lines, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}, {containers, plural, one {# container} other {# containers}} and {loads, plural, one {# load} other {# loads}} created.
done.skipped: {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} skipped.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Organization defaults used by the allocation engine and the demurrage alerts.
settings.name: Name
settings.baseCurrencyHelp: Every landed cost is reported in this currency. Changing it does not restate existing rates.
settings.methodHelp: Freight is usually allocated by volume for FCL and by weight for air or LCL; insurance and duty by value. Customs duty always uses the CIF basis.
settings.freeTimeHelp: Calendar days from discharge. Override per container when the carrier or terminal differs.

chooseOrganization.title: Choose your organization
chooseOrganization.body: Every purchase order, container and cost belongs to one organization.

errors.OVER_ALLOCATED: More would be loaded than the purchase-order line holds.
errors.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: That allocation method is not allowed for this cost type.
errors.FX_RATE_UNAVAILABLE: No exchange rate available for that date. Enter one manually.
errors.FX_RATE_INVALID: The exchange rate must be greater than zero.
errors.FX_DATE_REQUIRED: A date is needed to look the exchange rate up.
errors.MISSING_BASIS: Some lines have no allocation basis (weight, volume or value).
errors.NO_TARGET: This cost reaches no load: the container is empty.
errors.ALLOCATION_ERROR: The allocation could not be computed.
errors.TENANT_VIOLATION: This object belongs to another organization.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have the required role.
errors.XLSX_UNSUPPORTED: This Excel file cannot be read.
errors.ENCODING_UNKNOWN: The file encoding could not be determined.
errors.MAPPING_UNKNOWN_COLUMN: A mapped column does not exist in the file.
errors.IMPORT_ABORTED: Import aborted: no row was written.
errors.IMPORT_ALREADY_DONE: This import has already been committed.
errors.NOT_POSITIVE: The value must be strictly positive.
errors.FX_RATE_DEFAULTED: A default exchange rate was applied.
errors.NOT_AN_ACTUAL: Only an actual cost can replace an estimate.
errors.NOT_AN_ESTIMATE: The targeted cost is not an estimate.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.empty: No event recorded yet. Add the first one below, or connect a tracking provider.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.subtitle: {unread} unread · {total} in total
alerts.empty: No alert. They show up here when a container changes risk level, when an ETA moves by more than 12 h, or when tracking stays silent for 48 h.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.subtitle: {review} to review · {total} in total

upload.title: Upload an invoice
upload.hint: PDF, PNG or JPEG, 20 MB max. The invoice is read, then each line is proposed: nothing enters the costs without your confirmation.

invoices.empty: No invoice. Upload a forwarder invoice to read it.

detail.noLines: No line could be read. Fix the file or record the costs by hand.
detail.confirmedBanner: Invoice confirmed: {count} costs created on {date}. To undo, delete the costs on the container or the purchase order.

line.needsTarget: An accepted line needs a target

audit.title: History
audit.subtitle: Append-only log: what was done, by whom, when. Nothing here can be edited.

estimates.title: Estimated → actual
estimates.varianceHint: actual − estimated, on the cost types that have both
estimates.completenessDetail: {actual} of {expected} expected cost types have an invoice
estimates.noRateCards: No rate card: add some in the settings to estimate before the invoice.
estimates.failed: Could not apply the rate cards
estimates.closeReason: Reason (e.g. never invoiced by the forwarder)

rateCards.title: Estimation rate cards
rateCards.hint: One rate card per cost type. Applied on demand to a container to create estimated costs, later replaced by the real invoice. A DEMURRAGE rate card is read as a daily rate and feeds the avoided-demurrage estimate.
rateCards.failed: Could not save the rate card

variance.title: Month variance
variance.subtitle: Actual minus estimated, on actual costs dated in the month, by type and by purchase order. For month-end close.
variance.pairs: {count} actual costs paired with an estimate
variance.empty: No actual cost paired with an estimate this month.

erp.title: ERP connection
erp.hint: Reads the confirmed purchase orders of your ERP, imported through the same path as a file. The other way, a single write: a container's landed cost, created as a draft from its page, never validated by FreightSight.
erp.apiKeyHint: Created in Odoo, Preferences → Account Security → API keys. Sealed on our side, never shown again.
erp.fullSyncHint: Re-reads every order instead of only those changed since the last sync.

push.title: Write to the ERP
push.hint: The landed cost exactly as it will be created in Odoo, from the invoices allocated to this container. Estimates are never pushed.
push.pushed: Draft {name} created in Odoo. Nothing is validated: that is yours to do in Odoo.
push.pushFailed: Could not create in the ERP
push.previewFailed: Preview unavailable: the ERP did not answer
push.draftReminder: Created as a draft only: FreightSight never validates an entry in your books.

blocker.no_erp_connection: No ERP is connected. Go to Settings, ERP connection.
blocker.no_actual_costs: No invoiced cost is allocated to this container. Estimates are never pushed.
blocker.no_receipt: No done receipt in the ERP for {po_numbers}. A landed cost attaches to a receipt: the goods have to be received there first.
blocker.multiple_receipts: {count} receipts match these orders ({receipts}). Pushing to one of several receipts is not decided yet: do it by hand for now.
blocker.not_valued: Odoo cannot value a landed cost for {products}: their product category is not in automated valuation with a real cost method (FIFO or average). Odoo would refuse it at validation, so it is refused here.
blocker.unmatched_line: {po_number} line {line_no} ({sku}) matches no line on receipt {receipt}. Costs are pushed per line: every line has to match.
blocker.already_pushed: These costs were already pushed as {existing}.
blocker.partially_pushed: {count} of these costs were already pushed as {existing}. A landed cost adds to the stock valuation: pushing the whole set again would count the pushed ones twice. Add the new cost by hand in Odoo for now.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Landed cost by supplier, route or month; demurrage paid and avoided; exports for Excel and accounting. The time axis is the arrival of the goods, not the invoice date.
reports.empty: No goods arrived in the period. A container with no discharge, arrival or ETA date is not counted.
reports.dndHint: "Paid" = actual demurrage and detention costs. "Avoided" = days between the first risk alert and pickup, at the daily rate of your DEMURRAGE rate card. No rate card, no figure.
reports.dndEmpty: No container concerned in the period.
reports.exportsHint: Separator and decimals suited to French Excel (semicolon, comma), UTF-8 with BOM. Dates in ISO.
reports.variance: See the month's estimated → actual variance
reports.since: History recorded since 9 September 2026, at each recomputation.
